findings.description: Across the V124 direct renders, the lower bodice still shows visible triangular faceting around the front and side waist; the lowered all-jacket surface-placement ramp did not make a visible improvement.
Side and rear views still show the jacket hem projecting outward at the waist, with a pinched and uneven layered transition.
Crouch, sit, and prone views still show folded or tangled skirt strips and a cone/disk-like silhouette. Pleats and lamé/fencing-practice identity are not clear in the rendered garment.

nextAction: V124 changes the lower height transition used by the existing measured-surface placement on all jacket panels. Direct inspection of all five views and six poses still shows the same major silhouette and shading blockers, so this hypothesis is rejected. Keep the product rejected. The next bounded prototype should change the implicated panel geometry and skirt panel/deformation behavior; rebuild and inspect every required view and pose before any acceptance. Fit, material identity, shape keys, Unity/VRChat execution, package, and release remain unapproved.
